Strike Engine launches and trades on Meteora. All fees received by the protocol treasury go into call spreads with 1-day, 3-day, or 7-day expiries on BTC, SOL, HYPE and ZEC through Paradex. All net realized trading profits are allocated to Strike Engine buybacks.
